description_en: Queries the agent information for the SDK
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-ati-agent-register-info-market --client-token eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cC..... --agent-host example.com --agent-version 5.0.1 --max-results 100 --next-token 4698691 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAtiAgentRegisterInfoMarket

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a value on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the endpoint that the agent uses to provide external services
parameters.help_zh: Agent 对外提供服务 Endpoint 域名名称
parameters.name: agent_host

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used to start the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The trust authentication level of the agent. Valid values: BASIC (basic authentication), ENHANCED (enhanced authentication), and HIGHEST (highest authentication)
parameters.help_zh: Agent 信任认证级别，可选 BASIC（基础认证）、ENHANCED（增强认证）或 HIGHEST（最高认证）
parameters.name: trust_level

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The detailed information about the access denial. This field is returned only when RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

AuthAction.description_en: The unauthorized operation that you attempted to perform
AuthAction.description_zh: 尝试执行的未授权操作

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authorized principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the authorized principal owner

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 加密后的完整诊断信息

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The cause of the authentication failure. Valid values:

ExplicitDeny: explicit denial.
ImplicitDeny: implicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
导致鉴权失败的原因。具体取值为：
ExplicitDeny：显示拒绝
ImplicitDeny：隐式拒绝

AgentDescription.description_en: The capability description of the agent

AgentDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the agent

AgentHost.description_en: The host address of the agent

AgentId.description_en: The agent ID. It is uniformly assigned by CNNIC after real-name authentication. The agent ID serves as the unique identifier that binds the agent to the real-name authenticated registrant
AgentId.description_zh: AgentID，经过CNNIC实名认证后，由CNNIC统一分配。AgentID作为Agent与实名认证注册人绑定的唯一标识

AgentRegisterInfoId.description_en: The agent registration ID. It is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique on the platform. This ID is generated during the agent registration process. In a multi-step API registration process, this ID must be carried throughout to ensure that all steps are associated with the same agent to complete the registration
AgentRegisterInfoId.description_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册的多步流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，以确保各步骤关联至同一 Agent，完成完整的注册闭环

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return for this request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数

NextToken.description_en: The token used to start the next query

Status.description_en:
The status of the resolution record. Valid values:

Enable: enables resolution.

Disable: pauses resolution
Status.description_zh:
解析记录状态。取值：

Enable: 启用解析

Disable: 暂停解析

Basic authentication
